extension.summary: Turn Kodi into a Music Assistant (Sendspin) speaker
extension.description: Registers this Kodi box as a Sendspin player with Music Assistant. Music Assistant can then stream synchronised multi-room audio to Kodi, with title, artist and artwork shown on Kodi's Now Playing screen. Pure Python, no extra dependencies - works on Android / Fire TV, LibreELEC, Windows, macOS and Linux.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial community add-on. Uses the unencrypted Sendspin transition mode supported by Music Assistant 2.10 ("Allow legacy clients" must stay enabled).
extension.news: 1.0.0 - first stable release: Sendspin player for Music Assistant with clock-synced playback, auto-sync, Now Playing metadata and artwork, volume from Music Assistant, Kodi remote control of the queue, auto-discovery: Sendspin player role, clock-synced playback, metadata on Now Playing, volume/mute from Music Assistant, auto-discovery.
